current_fault.visible_result: black-white grain/noise, not a valid framebuffer

historical_evidence_policy.reason: Later official white/black diagnostics and measured PREVGH/PREVGL contradict current panel health, so historical refresh evidence is context only until the analog path is restored and reaccepted.

missing_hardware_facts: Replacement or cross-swapped FTS02 board identity and wiring check.
Deterministic solid-white and solid-black official one-plane frames with BUSY evidence after replacement.
Established positive PREVGH1 and negative PREVGL1 refresh rails, or equivalent vendor-specified rail evidence.
Visible current normal expression, partial expression transition, touch response, and maintenance boundary on the recovered panel.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not change expression, menu, recording, CEMP, or normal refresh policy to compensate for the analog fault.
Do not use TP_INT/PC6 or optional TP_RST/PC10 as e-paper recovery wiring.
Do not promote historical visible-refresh evidence as current acceptance.
Do not replace the panel module before FTS02 replacement/cross-swap unless new rail evidence contradicts the current diagnosis.
recovery_order: Replace or cross-swap ESP32-FTS02 before replacing the panel module.
Keep P3 at 2.2, fully latch the 24-pin e-paper FPC in P5, and verify 3.3 V logic power and common ground.
Under the Companion-WB55 workflow lock, run the staged White diagnostic, record one focused visible result, then repeat for Black.
If either frame fails, measure PREVGH1 and PREVGL1 during the verified refresh window and stop before expression/menu changes.
After solid white and black pass, run RestoreNormal, then prove the current expression, one partial transition, touch, and one maintenance boundary.

operator_sequence: Run White under Companion-WB55 lock, then record one focused visible-frame decision.
Only after White PASS, run Black and record one focused visible-frame decision.
Run RestoreNormal before any product interaction or runtime-resource acceptance.
If either visible frame fails, measure PREVGH1/PREVGL1 during that verified refresh and stop software changes.

wba_impact: Keep this failure target-local. WBA55/WBA65 reuse portable screen, expression, touch, and refresh-intent contracts but require their own panel power/rail implementation and real hardware evidence.
